title: ELA-STC: compliance-oriented electrical load analysis for multi-model AML-STC avionics installations
description: Open-source framework that evaluates one avionics equipment package against every model of an AML-STC with explicit analysis criteria (FAA AC 43.13-1B continuous load, CASA AC 21-38 average phase load, CASA AWB 24-007 breaker loading per circuit, 30 min battery endurance as reference criterion), exclusive radio receive/transmit states, emergency endurance at battery voltage by sequential depletion (CASA method and Peukert with separate state of health, state of charge and temperature), one-at-a-time sensitivity of method choices, Monte Carlo of physical variability, a browser version and a formula spreadsheet generator. Includes the Cessna 172 (14 V and 28 V) case study. Results indicate whether selected analysis criteria are met; they are not a finding of compliance with an approved certification basis.
